5358.title: Windows drive roots are absent from directory navigation
5358.rootCauseOneLine: The custom browser lists only directory children and stops at the current Windows drive root; it has no drive-root discovery path.
5358.proposedFix: Verify explicit-path access on native Windows, then add accessible drive-root discovery with matching SDK/CLI behavior and compatibility checks.
5358.caveats: Repeated controlled Windows-path/filesystem test on Linux; native Windows desktop and Google Drive mounts remain unverified. No fix PR because the native-reproduction gate is unmet.
